data.page_content_preview: Welcome to the Blueberry Scones recipe page! Here you'll find a delicious recipe for light, flaky scones packed with juicy blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze. Ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 8 tbsp cold unsalted butter, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 large egg, 1 cup fresh blueberries.
